test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Name the first Indian to join viceroy's executive council.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyendra Prasanna Sinha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satyendra Prasad Sinha **​

 
 
• Satyendra Prasad Sinha became the first Indian to join the **Viceroy’s executive council.**
 
• He was appointed as a **law member.**
 
• Satyendra Prasanna Sinha was a prominent lawyer and **statesman in British India.**
 
• He was the** first Governor** of Bihar and Orissa, the **first Indian Advocate-General **of Bengal.
 
• He was the first Indian to join the Executive Council of the Viceroy and the first Indian to join the British Ministry.
 
• He was the first Indian to be appointed in **1905 **as Bengal's Advocate-General, a post confirmed in **1908.**
 
• He was knighted on **1 January 1915** in the New Year Honours.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indians in the Council **

 
 
• **Satyendra Prasanna Sinha** (1909–1914)
 
• **C. Sankaran Nair** (1915–1919): Education
 
• **B. N. Sarma** (1920–1925): Revenue and Agriculture
 
• **Muhammad Habibullah** (1925–1930): Education, Health and Lands
 
• **C. P. Ramaswami Iyer:** Law (1931–1932), Commerce (1932), Information (1942)
 
• **Kurma Venkata Reddy Naidu **(1934–1937)
 
• **Kunwar Sir Jagdish Prasad:** Health, Education and Lands
 
• **Girija Shankar Bajpai** (1940): Health, Education
